about: Vendor marks from Simple Icons (CC0 1.0), used to identify the service a credential belongs to. Brands that asked Simple Icons to remove their mark are shown as a monogram instead. The marks are the trademarks of their owners; see assets/NOTICE.md.

environments.about: Which mark to draw for an environment. The name comes from WSL, Docker or the platform; a name that matches nothing is drawn as a monogram, and Windows always is, because its mark is not ours to redistribute. The patterns are matched case-insensitively and carry no inline flags: JavaScript has no (?i).
